subject: Rate metrics status: replication done, minibatch noise
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Replication status. F-measure optimization on COMPAS: done, matches the paper — the three-player algorithm beats the unconstrained baseline on F-measure while satisfying the rate constraints. KLD optimization on Adult: done as well; constraint satisfaction holds at convergence.

The practical finding for the platform API: with small minibatches the constraint estimates get noisy and we see transient violations mid-training even when the final solution is feasible. For the pilot we should surface constraint satisfaction as a convergence-time guarantee, not a per-step one, or users will file bugs at every wiggle.

Rafael has started sketching the constraint-spec schema with Oyin ahead of the mid-March review.

Fumiko
